title: In a grid, only the focused or hovered pane shows its header buttons

requirements.text: In grid mode, unfocused panes not under the pointer hide Talk, goals panel, remove-from-grid and close
requirements.check: eye: driven grid screenshot shows buttons only on the focused pane

requirements.text: Hovering an unfocused pane's header or pane shows its buttons; hidden buttons keep their space so the name does not move
requirements.check: manual: buttons fade with opacity, not removed (code: opacity + allowsHitTesting)

requirements.text: Single-session view keeps all buttons visible
requirements.check: eye: driven single-session screenshot shows Talk, panel and close

answers.observed: Driven screenshots: q2 only first pane has buttons; q3 after focus(nextlevel-app) its buttons appear and billing-page's vanish
answers.cause: keyPane follows window firstResponder via KVO; measured in q3
answers.absence: Hover reveal not driven deliberately; ghostlight showing is inferred from the real pointer position, not a controlled hover
answers.assumption: A real mouse click into a terminal makes it first responder, as SwiftTerm does; posted clicks in a background window did not, so real clicks are untested
answers.falsify: In the installed app, clicking into another pane leaves the old pane's buttons showing
